literature_notes: Four ledger lines were examined. L1, L2, and L3 (PMC9745132) all concern NTSR1, not NTSR2; moreover, all three fusions (Venus-YFP and RlucII) are placed at the NTSR1 C-tail, which is an intracellular terminus of a GPCR — disqualified on both grounds (wrong protein, cytoplasmic location). L4 (PMID 15637074) is the only line touching the NTSR2 gene: it reports an HA-tagged recombinant vNTS2, a 5-transmembrane splice variant of the rat NTS2/NTSR2 gene. This line fails on three independent grounds: (1) the HA tag insertion position is never stated — the clip gives no residue number, no loop name, and no primer sequence from which a junction could be derived; (2) the construct is a truncated splice isoform (281 aa, 5-TM), not the full-length 7-TM NTSR2 protein whose topology was provided; and (3) the reported result is that the tagged construct is 'poorly targeted to plasma membranes', meaning the insertion did not yield a surface-displayed receptor. Because no ledger line reports a tolerated tag insertion at a stated position on the extracellular face of full-length NTSR2, zero sites qualify. The vNTS2 HA-tag finding cannot be entered in other_positions either, because no residue number is available.
